transcript: I don't waste my time and I don't waste others time. Very mindful of my routine. I'm very mindful of the way that I structure my life. I don't do things out of boredom. Boredom is very dangerous. Mindful when I get too busy, because when I get too busy, sometimes I like to get into things that distract me. I know what's going on in my life at all times. Nothing is a surprise to me. And that's why I live in my world, so I know what's going on with me. I can't focus on what's going on with the external world and try to maintain my internal world at the same time.
